name: Dylan Stone
bio:
Dylan is a junior at Northwestern studying Biological Sciences and Religious Studies, with sights set on medical school and a career in surgery and emergency medicine. As Co-President of NEMO, he co-leads Northwestern's flagship student-run EMT-B program — the same one that put him on the rig in the first place.

Outside of NEMO, Dylan stays busy across campus: he serves as President of CKNU (Northwestern's food-recovery org) and as Treasurer for both Health Equity at Northwestern (HEN) and the GH Foundation. He also works as an EMT with Chatham Rescue Squad and conducts cardiology research on beta-blocker prescribing patterns in HFpEF, a project he presented at the American College of Cardiology conference earlier this year.

name: Liliana Awes
bio: Liliana is a junior at Northwestern University studying mathematics with a passion for urban emergency medicine. As Education Secretary for NEMO, she oversees the organization and delivery of educational programming, helping develop course content and facilitate training opportunities for members. || Outside of NEMO, Liliana pursues her interests in mentorship and emergency medical care. She serves as an organic chemistry tutor through Northwestern’s Academic Support and Learning Advancement program and volunteers as a counselor on a crisis hotline. She also works as a research intern at Minneapolis’s largest public hospital, where she contributes to emergency department research and quality improvement initiatives. In her free time, she enjoys competitive jigsaw puzzling.

name: Austin Okada
bio: Austin is a junior at Northwestern from the Chicagoland area, studying Biological Sciences and Global Health. Austin joined NEMO as a student freshman year, spent a year working as an EMT, and came back to mentor last year.

name: Shatakshi Chatterjee
bio: Shatakshi is a sophomore at Northwestern studying Neuroscience with a German minor, with a goal of going to medical school. As one of NEMO's External Affairs Secretaries, her goal is to expand NEMO's reach into Evanston and work with Evanston Public Library to develop a library program for kids interested in emergency medicine and medicine in general. || Outside of NEMO, Shatakshi enjoys singing and is involved in Brown Sugar A Cappella as Business Manager. She is also involved in PhiDE and enjoys being a Resident Assistant in Foster-Walker Complex. She is looking to work in EMS in the Northwest region of Illinois!

name: Sarah Lau
bio: I'm Sarah, a junior at Northwestern studying neuroscience. I became an EMT in high school, and I still volunteer as a 911 EMT with Westport EMS whenever I'm home. Outside of the classroom, I love baking, running, and traveling.

name: Prisha Goyal
bio: I'm Prisha Goyal and I'm from Austin, TX. I love painting with watercolors, going on runs, and cooking new things. I am a sophomore on the pre-med track, and currently work for Event Medical Solutions in Chicago as an EMT-B for various types of events, from concerts to sports games.
